package.name: so101_safety
package.description: SO-101 safety subsystem: perception-driven protective-stop trigger (depth_safety_monitor) and its enforcement nodes (trajectory_safety_gate for the JointTrajectory/JTC path, safety_pause_bridge for the MoveIt Servo path). Decoupled from so101_depth_demo -- depth_safety_monitor consumes an already-published depth topic (sensor_msgs/Image, 32FC1) rather than running its own model inference, so this package has no ML/vision dependencies. Intended as the home for future safety behaviours (diagnostics, watchdogs, ...).
